title: Turn completion renders duplicate bot response during message reconciliation
description: In web/components/EnabledWorkspace.tsx, when a terminal turn.completed event arrives from the SSE stream, it triggers reconcileMessages(activeTurn.channel_id). When listMessages resolves and updates messagesByChannel, React re-renders before the .then() callback clears turn. Because buildChatticusThreadMessages returns all committed messages plus the streaming turn item when turn is non-null, the newly committed bot message and the streaming shell are rendered simultaneously, causing the bot response to visibly duplicate in the thread before collapsing.
